concepts.definition: Public game page is not necessarily a paid commercial title
An account may represent a team or person; not automatically an individual developer
A game offered for positive payment under clearly defined conditions
A game without mandatory payment, possibly receiving voluntary donations
Specific downloadable or browser-playable release artifact
Play event, not necessarily a unique player or a purchase
File acquisition, not necessarily a customer or paid unit
Unit associated with an actual payment, subject to refund and bundle definitions
Eligible seller entity; not necessarily the same as individual game developer
Paying entity in defined period, requiring validated counting method
Settled seller amount after disclosed marketplace and processing deductions
Seller proceeds minus applicable operating costs, with labor treatment declared
Defined economic income divided by relevant labor hours
Eligible publisher cohort member with zero proceeds over an observed window
Explicit fraction of bundle proceeds attributed to an individual item
Defined paid outcome count over compatible exposure count

comparability_rules: Do not equate listings with distinct developers.
Do not equate free downloads or browser plays with purchases.
Separate paid units from bundle allocations and voluntary tips.
Distinguish gross revenue, settled proceeds, operating profit and hourly income.
A representative zero-earner statistic requires a defined cohort and observation window.
Use unknown rather than zero for unavailable demand, income or conversion statistics.
